items.source: Returns the base packages to scan for MongoDB mapped entities at startup. Will return the package name of the configuration class' (the concrete class, not this one here) by default. So if you have a com.acme.AppConfig extending MongoConfigurationSupport the base package will be considered com.acme unless the method is overridden to implement alternate behavior.
items.translation: 返回在启动时用于扫描 MongoDB 映射实体的基础包。默认情况下，将返回配置类（即具体类，而非此处所示的此类）的包名。因此，如果您有一个继承自MongoConfigurationSupport的com.acme.AppConfig类，则基础包将被视为com.acme，除非重写此方法以实现其他行为。
